name: Dock-TS-TW
blurb: Hover-sensitive dock with magnifying icons and spring animations.
description: A macOS-style dock using Framer Motion's mouseX tracking and spring physics. Icons magnify smoothly when cursor enters their distance threshold. Includes labels that fade in/out on hover. Fully customizable distance, magnification, and spring stiffness.
use_when: You want a polished app launcher or navigation dock with premium feel.
avoid_when: Touch-only interfaces — hover magnification is mouse-only.
a11y: Dock has toolbar role and aria-label. Items have role='button' and focus support (onFocus/onBlur). Labels show on interaction.
